title: Immutable CLI release updates
description: The active connection relay and manual update reuse the public installer. It builds a private uv tool environment for each release, installs it with a child-only umask 022, checks every credential-helper source with the release's own guard, evicts only the yoke-cli and yoke-contracts uv cache entries and reinstalls once when cached sources are group- or other-writable, verifies the candidate and atomically replaces the current pointer file (no symlinks, on every OS). Commands keep importing their original release while the next command uses the new one. Cleanup renames an old release out of the releases folder before deleting it: Windows refuses that rename while a process holds a file in the release open, and on macOS and Linux it also needs the release lease that running commands and the hook resident hold shared. A failed candidate preserves the active release; cleanup refusal names the recovery. Source launcher and uninstall use the same owner.
